Ordinary smoking bar, not a decent lounge
Apr 2023 • Solo
While I was an occasional visitor when in Saigon, the last visit made me re-think to look for other places.
While the food is good, the staff friendly too, the ambience is highly compromised by the guests who do not mind to smoke constantly (in a restaurant !, its not a bar), while sitting next to other guests who are eating. I noticed that on many of my previous visits, but thought it was an exception. Yesterday seemingly upper scale visitors, yet lacking basic manners, did not mind to smoke in drinking and dining section - even cigars. Vesper should put up signs, that smoking is not allowed in the dining area, which I would expect in a $$$$ lounge, or change to become an ordinary $ bar. Until then, I won't go back again

Casual Lounge with Serious Drinks
Aug 2020
I have been coming to Vesper since the opening and it remains a great spot for a casual lunch, relaxed dinner or a night of cocktails. Nicola and the bar staff are true experts at the cocktail and whatever your drink, they will most likely make the best version of it that you will have anywhere in Saigon. Nicola is really a true mixologist. Great to just tell him “whatever you suggest” and see what inventive and delicious concoction he comes up with. If you’re looking for a regular bar that’s easy to settle into, easy to come back to over and over with friends or by yourself, Vesper is the spot. Staff is friendly and cool.

Don’t bother!
Aug 2019 • Couples
We popped in here for a drink and some lunch and wish we hadn’t bothered. I normally look for the good in everything....but I really struggled here. Maybe we visited at the wrong time of day? But the atmosphere was awful, we weren’t made to feel welcome, the drinks were expensive (for Ho Chi Minh) and the menu was unappealing, so we left after having 2 draft tiger beers and having to pay a 5% service fee to order at the bar and carry our own drinks to the table! What service? All she did was pour the drinks into glasses!

Ok so the decor was nice and it had outside seating, opposite construction site boarding, so apart from watching the cars and bikes go by it was a bit boring.

There are certainly much better places in Ho Chi Minh to visit!
